say:2:1322136002:1.text: Yes, Valka. These two are Acolyte Ogden and Maxim. They have pledged their aid to us and try to purify the undead with the Divine Light.
say:2:1322136002:1.source_cn: 是的，瓦丽卡姐姐。这两位是奥格列修士和马克西姆修士，他...

say:3:1322136003:1.text: Excellent. In the name of those soldiers, I thank you for your assistance.
say:3:1322136003:1.source_cn: 太好了！我代表那些战士感谢你们的帮助。

say:5:1322136004:1.text: Y-you're... Dura above, you're the one honored by the Snowspire Festival, the hero who defeated the Hypogean!
say:5:1322136004:1.source_cn: 你……你是……艾雅在上，你是冬日祭典纪念的那位、那位打...

say:6:1322136005:1.text: Those are all things of the past. The Frost Furie has been sealed, and what I have to do now is to help those warriors who have become the undead regain their last dignity.
say:6:1322136005:1.source_cn: 那些都是过去的事情了。冰之恶魔已经被封印，如今我要做的...

say:7:1322136006:1.text: Valka, have you found a way to temporarily awaken the memories of the undead warriors?
say:7:1322136006:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐，你找到能够暂时唤起活死人记忆的方法了吗？

say:8:1322136007:1.text: This sword should bear some effect. Though I cannot wholly return them to consciousness and sanity, I am sure they may find their senses again, if only for a short time.
say:8:1322136007:1.source_cn: 这把剑应该能起到一定效果。虽然无法彻底让他们清醒，但短...

choice_prompt:9:1322136007.text: This sword should bear some effect. Though I cannot wholly return them to consciousness and sanity, I am sure they may find their senses again, if only for a short time.
choice_prompt:9:1322136007.source_cn: 这把剑应该能起到一定效果。虽然无法彻底让他们清醒，但短时间内，我有把握让他们找回理智。

say:10:1322136008:1.text: This sword is imbued with the strength of the God of Death and the indomitable souls of my brethren. Should I stir its power, I may yet rouse those warriors, even if briefly.
say:10:1322136008:1.source_cn: 这把剑里蕴含着死神的神力与我的战友们不屈的灵魂。如果我...

say:11:1322136009:1.text: Perchance... they still know me, their former companion, for their souls are bound to mine.
say:11:1322136009:1.source_cn: 也许……他们还记得我这位曾经的战友，因为他们的灵魂与我同在。

say:12:1322136010:1.text: I shall first wield this blade to rouse the souls of the warriors, granting them a fleeting moment to reclaim their true selves.
say:12:1322136010:1.source_cn: 我会先用这把剑唤起战士们的灵魂，让他们短暂找回自我。

say:13:1322136011:1.text: Next, we shall require the aid of the two acolytes. You must seize the moment when their consciousness returns and wield the power of Divine Light to purify them so that they may find eternal rest.
say:13:1322136011:1.source_cn: 接下来就需要两位修士先生的帮助了。你们得抓住他们找回自...

say:14:1322136012:1.text: In the name of the goddess, I swear to you that I will do my best to appease the souls of these brave men.
say:14:1322136012:1.source_cn: 以女神之名，我向您发誓，我会尽我的全力去安抚这些英勇之...

say:16:1322136013:1.text: In Dura's name, we will do what we need to do, Lady Valka.
say:16:1322136013:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我们明白该怎么做了，瓦丽卡女士。

say:17:1322136014:1.text: If you permit us, we'll need a few days to prepare. We're not high priests or exorcisers, and we're not skilled in the Divine Light. We'll need to prepare some tools to assist us.
say:17:1322136014:1.source_cn: 如果允许的话，请您给我们几天时间做准备。我们并非高阶圣...

say:18:1322136015:1.text: Certainly, I will find an appropriate location to perform this ritual of purification during this time.
say:18:1322136015:1.source_cn: 当然。我会在这段时间里找一个合适的地方来进行这次净化仪式。

say:19:1322136016:1.text: I shall see you all in a few days time.
